question: What is the meaning of environmental cost indicators a1-d in relation to sustainability, environmental cost indicators?
description: The environmental cost indicators a1-d in relation to sustainability refer to the factors used to assess the environmental impact of building materials. These indicators help in evaluating the sustainability of materials based on their environmental performance, such as the number of affected persons per year, the ratio of reusable building components, and the normalized environmental performance of each material. These indicators play a crucial role in determining the overall environmental score of building materials, with higher scores indicating better environmental performance.
